title: AgentSkillsManifest
description: Project-level manifest declaring desired skills, version constraints, registries, and install targets. Managed by skpm. Committed to the consuming project repository.

version.description: Manifest format version. Must be 1 for this schema.

default_registry.description: Name of the registry to use when a skill entry does not specify a 'source'. Must match a key under 'registries'.

registries.description: Named registry configurations. Keys are registry names referenced by skill 'source' fields and 'default_registry'.

skills.description: Desired skills for this project. Each entry declares a skill, its version constraint, source registry, and install target.

metadata.description: Freeform extension metadata for the manifest. Not validated beyond being an object.

RegistryConfig.title: RegistryConfig
RegistryConfig.description: Configuration for a named skill registry. Remote registries require 'url'. The 'local' type requires 'path' instead.

repo.description: Repository or path within the registry host. Used by Artifactory and similar.

project.description: Project identifier within the registry. Used by GitLab package registries.

path.description: Filesystem path for local registry type.

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to include in requests to this registry. Values should be static strings. For secret values, use auth instead.

endpoints.description: Override specific API endpoint paths for non-standard registry deployments.

metadata.description: Freeform extension metadata for this registry config.

RegistryAuth.title: RegistryAuth
RegistryAuth.description: Authentication configuration for a registry. Credentials must be stored in environment variables, not in this file.

token_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the bearer token. Used when type is 'bearer' or 'header'.

username_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the username. Used when type is 'basic'.

password_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the password. Used when type is 'basic'.

header_name.description: HTTP header name to send the credential in. Used when type is 'header'.

SkillEntry.title: SkillEntry
SkillEntry.description: A desired skill in the project manifest.

name.description: Skill name. Must match the pattern in skill.schema.json.

namespace.description: Skill namespace. Defaults to 'default' when omitted.

version.description: Version constraint for this skill. Accepts exact SemVer or constraint expressions. 'latest' is allowed for local experiments but must not be committed for production use.

source.description: Registry name from 'registries' to install this skill from. Falls back to 'default_registry' when omitted.

target.description: Filesystem path where the skill should be installed in the consuming project.

platforms.description: Platforms to generate output for during install. Must use canonical platform names.

path.description: Local filesystem path to the skill source for monorepo or local development scenarios. Mutually exclusive with 'source' in intent, but both may be present for fallback.

ref.description: Git commit, branch, or tag reference. Supported by registry adapters that resolve from Git (e.g. gitlab, github).

metadata.description: Freeform extension metadata for this skill entry.
